knowledge_units.context_summary: The paper presents a short proof of a refinement regarding the regularity of powers of ideals, which implies a conjecture by Hà and generalizes results by Eisenbud and Harris. It establishes that the limit of the end degree of local cohomology minus a linear term exists and is at least the initial degree of the module. The work also compares the cohomology of stalks and fibers of projective morphisms to analyze Castelnuovo-Mumford regularities.

It establishes that the limit of the regularity minus the linear term equals the maximum end degree of local cohomology of the stalks of a specific projection. A corollary provides a geometric criterion for the regularity of saturated powers, linking it to the existence of positive-dimensional fibers or contracted subvarieties.
